To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the application of HTR reactors to contemporary large-output steam power plants on ships is not possible.

the application of the proposed HTR to ship power plants of a high output (over 200 MW) is possible, but requires a lot of work on reactor and power plant design and development, as well as a number of tests in a real environment.

“Application of the helium to cooling the HTR reactor for the ship nuclear power plant with variable output is possible and it may lead to increase of the plant efficiency by several percentage points.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
analysis of possible application for ship nuclear power plants of the HTR reactor cooled by helium.
analysis of possible application to the ship power plants of the high-temperature nuclear reactors.
the analysis of the possibility of application of the HTR reactor for generating the steam in contemporary ship power plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the application of HTR to the nuclear steam-turbine plant of the large output is not possible due to the fact that the power output of the HTR is not variable.
the application of the high-temperature reactor to the ship nuclear power plant is not justified at present.
the proposed high-temperature reactor with helium cooling can be used for generating the steam in the ship power plants.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed HTR reactors can be used for generating electricity in the contemporary large-output steam power plants with the use of steam turbines and with the use of the Rankine cycle.
the application of high-temperature nuclear reactors for generating steam in large-output ship steam-turbines is feasible and would result in a considerable increase of the power plant efficiency.

the use of HTR reactors with helium as a coolant in the proposed thermal cycles is feasible, and that the application of such a system would result in an increase of the efficiency of the ship power plant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed HTR reactor is a promising solution for contemporary large-output steam-turbine ship power plants.
application of HTR reactors to contemporary ship power plants is possible and it can lead to increase of efficiency and decrease of fuel consumption of such plants.
HTR reactors are a very promising solution in the field of marine nuclear power plants, especially for ships of large size, where the use of the nuclear power plant is the best solution.
